recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core source follow-up is recommended unless Patient Care reopens the broader Clinical Module wording after FHIR-46526.
issue_request: FHIR-14948 was a Published Patient Care change request for STU3 asking to replace the Clinical Summary Module use case text "Retrieving a list of the patient's Problem List" with "Retrieving the patient's problems" to avoid confusion with the List resource.
initial_application: The change was historically applied in commit 722ed5c93f4bc9828e96f0f5b476bedc3486fb92, whose message explicitly lists GF#14948 and duplicate GF#15863 among Clinical Summary Module typo fixes and whose patch changed the old wording to "Retrieving the patient's problems".
additional_context: The current source/hierarchy.xml includes clinicalsummary-module.html as the active Clinical Summary page. A later Applied Patient Care issue, FHIR-46526, intentionally removed the standalone "Retrieving the patient's problems" bullet by merging it into "Documenting and retrieving the patient's conditions", with accompanying text that Condition includes problems, diagnoses, and health concerns. Community searches found no conflicting Zulip or Confluence direction.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The current source no longer contains the confusing "Problem List" use-case phrase, and the later applied wording satisfies FHIR-14948 without reintroducing List-resource ambiguity.

related_jiras.note: Duplicate typo report for the same Clinical Summary Module Problem List wording.
Later Applied Patient Care clarification intentionally folded "Retrieving the patient's problems" into the Condition use case.
